content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing issues installing [product_name] [version_no] on my Windows 7 PC. It seems Java might be causing the problem, as the installation stops at 99% and then fails to complete.
You need to run the installation with administrator rights on Windows. Use the right mouse button to do this. Also, why not use the latest [version_no] instead of the older one?

I have installed [product_name] [version_no], [version_no], and [version_no] in parallel on my Windows 7 64-bit system without issues. Do you have the original installation CD? If so, you can update to the current [version_no]. When upgrading [product_name], do you install it over an existing installation or after uninstalling the previous version?

analysis.insight_summary: A user encounters a failure installing [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 7, with the installation process stopping at 99%, possibly due to Java. Other users report parallel installations of multiple versions succeed, hinting that the problem could be related to administrator permissions, installation media, or software environment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates a smooth and error-free installation of [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 7, regardless of Java setup or administrator permissions.
